title: Why true GIS-centric permitting is the foundation for future innovation
summary: Trimble® Unity Permit is built to work with ArcGIS mapping and spatial capabilities. Built on Esri ArcGIS®, the world’s most powerful GIS software, Trimble Unity Permit powers better decision-making and delivers significant business value.
